description: This file defines a Java interface for a live command related to deleting a 'thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends base interfaces for live commands and thing modification commands, serving as an entry point for creating command answer builders within the 'delete thing' command context.

classes.description: A Java interface representing a live command for deleting a 'thing', providing access to command creation and answering mechanisms within the Eclipse Ditto framework.
